title: Zoo Scene 8 — Animal Feature Clues
purpose: Support adjectives, visible body features and clue-based identification in a zoo scene.

sentenceModels: The giraffe has a long neck.
The elephant is big and grey.

adultSupport.focus: Use descriptive clues to identify each animal and compare them.
starterPrompts: Which animal has a long neck?
Can you find the big grey animal?
expansionPrompts: Tell me two clues for each animal.
Which animals are big and which are small?

visualAudit: Reviewed in Wave 3 Batch 3 automatic pass against the main teaching targets.
